exp1.explanation: No events are lost because Kafka/Redpanda retains an append-only commit log and tracks consumer group offsets.

exp2.explanation: Adding a second consumer triggers group coordinator partition rebalancing, splitting partitions across instances.

exp3.explanation: Failure rate exceeded 10% threshold in almost every 1-minute window, firing alerts continuously.

exp4.explanation: With 0 waiting time, late arriving events (>60s delayed webhooks) find their windows already closed and are rejected.
